evidence.evidence: Reducing correspondence ambiguity in loosely labeled training data
We develop an approach to reduce correspondence ambiguity in training data where data items are associated with sets of plausible labels.
Our domain is images annotated with keywords where it is not known which part of the image a keyword refers to.
